title: Rishikesh in one day
summary: A compact day of ghats, bridges and the evening aarti.

plan.title: Ghats, bridges and aarti
plan.text: Morning at Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula, lunch at a cafe in Tapovan, then the Beatles Ashram if open. Finish with the Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat.

seasonAlt: In monsoon the river is high; skip river activities.
note: Comfortable for one day. Add a second day for rafting or yoga.

title: Haridwar temples and Ganga Aarti
summary: Temples in the morning and the Har Ki Pauri evening aarti.

plan.title: Mansa Devi, Chandi Devi and Har Ki Pauri
plan.text: Take a ropeway up to Mansa Devi in the morning, visit Chandi Devi or Maya Devi, then reach Har Ki Pauri early for the dusk aarti.

seasonAlt: In summer visit the ghat later in the evening.
note: Comfortable. Expect heavy crowds on festival days.

title: Mussoorie highlights in one day
summary: A day trip from Dehradun covering Mall Road, Gun Hill and Camel's Back Road.

plan.title: Dehradun to Mussoorie and back
plan.text: Leave Dehradun early. Walk Camel's Back Road, take the Gun Hill ropeway and finish on Mall Road before heading back.
plan.drive: About 1.5-2 hours each way (35 km) depending on traffic

seasonAlt: Weekends in May-June are crowded; start early or choose a weekday.
note: Balanced; the road is the main time cost.

title: Dehradun local attractions
summary: Robber's Cave, FRI, Mindrolling Monastery and Paltan Bazaar.

plan.title: Gorge, campus, monastery and bazaar
plan.text: Start with Robber's Cave in the morning, then the Forest Research Institute, lunch, Mindrolling Monastery and evening in Paltan Bazaar.

seasonAlt: Skip Robber's Cave in heavy monsoon.
note: Easy and flexible.

title: Nainital sightseeing in one day
summary: Boating, a viewpoint and Mall Road.

plan.title: Lake, temple and viewpoints
plan.text: Boat on Naini Lake in the morning, visit Naina Devi, take the cable car or walk to Snow View Point, and finish on Mall Road.

seasonAlt: Rain can close the cable car; have an indoor plan.
note: Comfortable if you are already in Nainital.

title: Tehri Lake day trip from Rishikesh
summary: A long day with a lot of driving; better as an overnight.

plan.title: Rishikesh to Tehri and back
plan.text: Leave early, reach the lake in the late morning, do one activity, then start back. Keep an hour of buffer for mountain roads.

seasonAlt: Avoid heavy monsoon days because of landslides.
note: Rushed; make it two days if you can.

title: Rishikesh and Haridwar in two days
summary: Haridwar aarti on day one and Rishikesh yoga and bridges on day two.

plan.title: Haridwar
plan.text: Arrive, visit Mansa Devi and attend the Har Ki Pauri aarti at dusk.

plan.title: Rishikesh
plan.text: Drive to Rishikesh in the morning, visit Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula, attend the evening aarti at Triveni Ghat.

seasonAlt: In monsoon skip river activities.
note: Comfortable and well paced.

title: Mussoorie and Dhanaulti
summary: Mussoorie for the town and Dhanaulti for the forest.

plan.title: Dehradun to Mussoorie
plan.text: Drive up, visit Gun Hill and Camel's Back Road, evening on Mall Road.

plan.title: Mussoorie to Dhanaulti and return
plan.text: Drive to Dhanaulti, visit Eco Parks and Surkanda Devi if time, then return to Dehradun.
plan.drive: About 1-1.5 hours to Dhanaulti and 2-3 hours back to Dehradun

seasonAlt: In winter Dhanaulti is likelier to have snow; check road conditions.
note: Balanced; the second day has more driving.

title: Nainital and the nearby lakes
summary: Nainital on day one and Bhimtal and Sattal on day two.

plan.title: Kathgodam to Nainital
plan.text: Drive up, boating on Naini Lake, evening on Mall Road.

plan.title: Bhimtal and Sattal
plan.text: Visit Bhimtal, then Sattal for a forest walk, and head back to Kathgodam.

seasonAlt: In winter nights are cold; carry layers.
note: Comfortable.

title: Kanatal and Tehri Lake
summary: A quiet stay in Kanatal with a visit to the Tehri reservoir.

plan.title: Dehradun to Kanatal
plan.text: Drive via Mussoorie; short walk to Surkanda Devi.

plan.title: Kanatal to Tehri Lake and onward
plan.text: Drive to Tehri Lake in the morning, then return towards Rishikesh or Dehradun.
plan.drive: About 2-2.5 hours to Tehri, then 2.5-3 hours back

seasonAlt: Snow possible in winter; check roads.
note: Balanced; driving takes a fair share of the second day.

title: Chakrata and nearby viewpoints
summary: A quiet cantonment town with waterfalls and forest.

plan.title: Dehradun to Chakrata
plan.text: Drive via Vikasnagar, check in, visit Chilmiri Neck at sunset.

plan.title: Tiger Falls and Deoban
plan.text: Morning at Tiger Falls and Deoban, then return.

seasonAlt: Tiger Falls is best after the monsoon; roads can be bad in rain.
note: Balanced; carry ID.

title: Rishikesh and Shivpuri rafting
summary: A weekend of river rafting and a riverside camp.

plan.title: Rishikesh town
plan.text: Ghats, bridges and the evening aarti.

plan.title: Shivpuri rafting
plan.text: Book a rafting trip from Shivpuri side with a licensed operator, and finish at Rishikesh.
plan.stay: Return or camp by the river

seasonAlt: Rafting is generally suspended in monsoon.
note: Comfortable; confirm operator licence and safety gear.

title: Dehradun, Mussoorie and Dhanaulti
summary: A relaxed family trip starting in Dehradun.

plan.title: Dehradun
plan.text: Robber's Cave, FRI and Paltan Bazaar.

plan.title: Mussoorie
plan.text: Drive up; Gun Hill, Camel's Back Road and Mall Road.

plan.title: Dhanaulti and return
plan.text: Eco Parks and forest walks, then drive down.
plan.drive: About 1-1.5 hours to Dhanaulti; 2-3 hours back

seasonAlt: In winter Dhanaulti may be snowy.
note: Comfortable.

title: Rishikesh, Devprayag and Tehri
summary: A mix of temple, confluence and lake.

plan.title: Rishikesh
plan.text: Ghats, bridges and the evening aarti.

plan.title: Devprayag and Tehri
plan.text: Stop at Devprayag, continue to New Tehri.
plan.drive: About 2-2.5 hours to Devprayag; 1.5 hours further to Tehri

plan.title: Tehri Lake and return
plan.text: Morning at the lake, then return to Rishikesh.

seasonAlt: Monsoon landslides can delay this route.
note: Balanced; driving is a big part of day two.

title: Nainital, Bhimtal and Mukteshwar
summary: Lakes and an orchard ridge in Kumaon.

plan.title: Nainital sights
plan.text: Snow View, Naina Devi and Tiffin Top.

plan.title: Bhimtal to Mukteshwar
plan.text: Visit Bhimtal and drive to Mukteshwar for views.

seasonAlt: Winter nights are very cold at Mukteshwar.
note: Comfortable.

title: Almora, Binsar and Jageshwar
summary: Temples, sweets and forest in Kumaon.

plan.title: Kathgodam to Almora
plan.text: Drive up; evening in the bazaar for bal mithai.

plan.title: Kasar Devi and Almora
plan.text: Morning at Kasar Devi and Chitai temple.

seasonAlt: Winters are cold; Binsar can be snowy.
note: Balanced; the last day has long driving.

title: Auli and Joshimath
summary: Snow and views near Joshimath. Check subsidence advisories.

plan.title: Auli and optional Badrinath day trip
plan.text: Optional visit to Badrinath if open.

seasonAlt: Skiing depends on snowfall; confirm before booking.
note: Balanced; two long driving days.

title: Chopta, Tungnath and Chandrashila
summary: An easy trek and a forest retreat.

plan.title: Rishikesh to Chopta
plan.text: A long drive via Rudraprayag and Ukhimath.

plan.title: Tungnath and Chandrashila
plan.text: Early walk to Tungnath and on to Chandrashila.

seasonAlt: In winter the temple is closed and the trail is snowy.
note: Balanced; two long driving days.

title: Garhwal exploration in a week
summary: A broad loop of Garhwal's hill stations and holy towns.
seasonAlt: Monsoon: skip Tehri and Kanatal side.
note: Balanced.

title: Kumaon in a week
summary: Lakes, ridges and Himalayan views across Kumaon.
seasonAlt: Winter nights are cold at higher stops.
note: Balanced; no day is excessive.

title: Char Dham Yatra in 11 days
summary: The traditional circuit by road with a walk to Yamunotri and Kedarnath. Registration is required.

plan.title: Haridwar to Barkot
plan.text: Long drive via Dehradun and Mussoorie.

plan.title: Yamunotri
plan.text: Drive to Janki Chatti and walk to the temple; return to Barkot.
plan.drive: About 1.5-2 hours each way plus a 5-6 km walk each way

plan.title: Guptkashi to Sonprayag, walk to Kedarnath
plan.text: Walk or helicopter option; overnight at Kedarnath.
plan.drive: About 1.5 hours to Sonprayag, then 16 km walk

seasonAlt: Open only April/May to October/November; monsoon has landslide risk. Add buffer days.
note: Balanced on paper but weather can force extra days. Add 1-2 buffer days.

title: Valley of Flowers and Hemkund
summary: A bloom-season trek for fit beginners.

plan.title: Buffer
plan.text: Buffer day for landslides or rest.

seasonAlt: The valley is open only in season.
note: Balanced; the buffer day is important.

title: Family holiday: Nainital and Corbett
summary: Wildlife, lakes and a quiet hill station for families.

plan.title: Safari and rest
plan.text: Morning safari; relax by the river.

plan.title: Return
plan.text: Back to Delhi by road or via Kathgodam.

seasonAlt: Most Corbett core zones are closed in the monsoon (only Jhirna, Dhela and Garjia stay open all year); check zone dates on corbettgov.org.
note: Comfortable; kid-friendly pacing.

title: Spiritual journey: Haridwar to Rudraprayag
summary: Ghats, ashrams, confluences and a temple trek.

plan.title: Haridwar
plan.text: Evening aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

seasonAlt: In winter the Tungnath temple is closed.
note: Relaxed except for Day 7.

title: Peaceful mountain retreats
summary: Quiet villages in Garhwal with long stays and few activities.
seasonAlt: Monsoon roads can be rough.
note: Comfortable; no rushed days.

title: Remote villages and culture in Kumaon
summary: Long drives to the far east with local culture and views.
seasonAlt: Monsoon landslides are common on this route.
note: Balanced; long drives on days 3, 5 and 8.

title: Adventure road trip
summary: Rafting, a meadow trek and the Joshimath area in ten days.
seasonAlt: The Valley of Flowers is open only June-October; replace with Auli extra days outside that.
note: Rushed: several long drives; add buffer days.
